scope: Four newly generated matched surface-refinement studies plus20 genuinely new compositions. Existing WC attempt budgets remain closed; matched studies test a new owner-requested finish, not old action repairs.
expansion_gate: At least3of4 studies show material reduction in competing texture without major drawing, identity, silhouette, world-depth or handling regression at native and actual phone size. AI evidence only; no owner comfort/approval inferred. If unmet, use documented single repairs or an explicitly revised drawing mechanism before expansion, preserving negative evidence.

entries.title: The Missing Span — quieter surfaces
entries.caption: The same crossing, with detail concentrated around Riven and the landing.
entries.visual_brief: Keep the exact wide city-gulf composition, camera, airborne adult Riven, silver swept hair, petrol jacket, one saber, both separated ledges and the small fox on the far landing. Preserve the dark blue atmosphere, cyan seam endpoints, wetness and immense inhabited depth. Redraw paving as broad dark slabs with a few meaningful joins and broad reflected-light shapes, not chipped glitter. Group distant windows into restrained clusters separated by large quiet façades. Simplify the trailing cyan ribbons into a small coherent directional gesture. Preserve the fine face contour, clear hands/weapon, fox silhouette and structural edges; do not change their pose or turn the city into empty blocks.

entries.title: The Larger Resident — calmer scale
entries.caption: The same two adventurers and giant threat, with quieter material surfaces.
entries.visual_brief: Keep the exact composition and huge scale: silver-haired Riven on left, ponytailed muscular adult Senn beside him with her full lance, and the single immense long-necked organic Regent over inhabited streets. Keep complete weapons, bodies, creature silhouette/leg positions and the pale throat's shape. Redraw the Regent's internal mosaic of cracks/scales into broad continuous dark armor planes and a pale neck described by a few large shaded forms. Keep armor boundaries and the anatomy, not the dense little shards inside them. Group tower floors/windows and wet street reflections; retain just enough purposeful city detail to prove scale. Preserve all warm/cool mood and giant-world depth. Do not replace Senn or add another creature.

entries.title: Riven Hale — selective detail
entries.caption: The same face and silhouette, with quieter cloth, hair and environment.
entries.visual_brief: Keep the exact matching portrait/full-figure composition and this specific adult Riven's attractive heavy-lidded face, narrow features, restrained crooked smile, silver swept-back hair, petrol cropped jacket, one shoulder shell and complete held saber. Redraw hair as designed locks with a few selective interior lines; preserve volume, hairline and asymmetry without hundreds of equal strands. Cloth retains its tailoring and major tension folds but loses crackled leather/fabric grain and excess small creases. Skin is clean drawn tone, eyes/lids/lips precise rather than airbrushed. Quiet the paving and window noise behind the full figure using large light/shadow shapes. Preserve existing stance/ledge geometry and blade grip; no face replacement, beauty filter or redesign.

entries.title: Rift Hound — broad material planes
entries.caption: The same predator, with anatomy carried by shape instead of cracked texture.
entries.visual_brief: Keep the exact full four-legged Rift Hound pose, wedge head, pale jaw, muscular shoulders, broad back-plate silhouette, four grounded paws and one tail. Preserve threat, organic weight and the wet city setting. Redraw the interiors of the dark plates as broad smooth opaque black-glass planes with restrained satin reflections. Remove the pervasive mosaic cracks, glitter flecks and tiny scale facets INSIDE the existing shapes. Retain deliberate contour/plate-boundary lines and a few deep creases that explain shoulder, chest and limb roots. The pale jaw keeps its shape and tooth construction without extra micro-scratches. Simplify city and paving into layered architectural masses and broad reflection bands. Do not remove limbs/plates or smooth the monster into a plastic toy; contour and selective painted shading must still feel drawn.
